'''Readout glasses''' were [[Eye/Legends|eyewear]] with transparent lens that could be connected to a standard [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. The glasses allowed the wearer to view data that scrolled on the lens while engaged in other activities.<ref name="EGWT" />
